comments.author: Priya Sharma
comments.body: Contract tests added for duplicate sort values. Verified full walk returns 40/40. Shipping.

content.text: Contract tests added for duplicate sort values. Verified full walk returns 40/40. Shipping.

List endpoints that page with a single-column cursor skip rows when the sort column contains ties. On GET /v2/issues?orderBy=updatedAt&cursor=..., any issues sharing the same updatedAt as the cursor boundary vanish from subsequent pages.

Expected: every issue appears exactly once across the full page walk, with stable ordering for ties. Actual: the opaque cursor stores only updatedAt, so the comparison updatedAt > :cursor drops siblings that share that timestamp. A workspace with 40 issues updated in the same millisecond lost 6 of them between page 1 and page 2.

Likely cause is the cursor codec encoding a single scalar instead of a composite (updatedAt, id) key. Seek predicates need updatedAt > :ts OR (updatedAt = :ts AND id > :id) with id as the tie-breaker.
Integrations that sync the full issue set under-report totals and miss updates. Affects any list route using the shared cursor helper — issues, comments, and projects.
